title: e2e Ruffle oracle: motion-tween / motion-guide play static (diffPixels=0) + bitmap renders blank (red=0)
description:
RESOLVED. Three independent SWF-compiler/encoder defects root-caused and fixed. EVIDENCE (fresh e2e run, CI unset, ruffle assets restored to apps/desktop/public/ruffle from @ruffle-rs/ruffle 0.2.0):

npx playwright test e2e/motion-tween.spec.ts:330 e2e/motion-guide.spec.ts:675 e2e/bitmap-rendering.spec.ts:202 => 3 passed (28.5s).
  (A) motion-tween-diff: nonWhiteEarly=2500 nonWhiteMid=2500 diffPixels=5000 (was 0, need >50).
  (B) motion-guide frame2 apex: posRegion=2500 negRegion=0 (was posCount=0).
  (C) bitmap-rendering: PASS (red pixels present; was red=0).

ROOT CAUSES + FIXES:
(A) getTweenedFrame motion branch interpolated only displayObject transform x/y; the fixture encodes movement in SHAPE GEOMETRY (path coords x=50->x=450, transform x=0 both keyframes) so in-betweens emitted no HasMove PlaceObject2 (tx constant). Fix (packages/core/src/model/timeline-query.ts): fold each keyframe shape geometric origin into the tween target, interpolate on-stage position, subtract START origin back out (in-betweens reuse start char). No-op for transform-based tweens / instances.
(B) frame-script -> DoAction emit gated on frame.isKeyframe; the oracle parks stop() on a NON-keyframe in-between tween frame, so it was dropped and the movie never stopped at the apex. Fix (packages/swf/src/compiler/frames.ts + sprite.ts): emit DoAction for any frame whose script is non-empty regardless of isKeyframe.
(C) DefineBitsLossless2 ZlibBitmapData and DefineBitsJPEG3 alpha were compressed with fflate deflateSync = raw DEFLATE (0x63...), but SWF spec/Ruffle flate2 ZlibDecoder require a ZLIB stream (0x78). Bitmap silently failed to decode -> blank. Fix (packages/swf/src/bitmaps.ts): use zlibSync for all 3 lossless paths.

UNIT REGRESSIONS ADDED: packages/swf/src/__tests__/ruffle-oracle-defects.test.ts (3 tests: (A) HasMove PO2 tx ramps across span; (B) DoAction emitted at in-between frame index 2; (C) lossless ZlibBitmapData starts 0x78 + decodes to red ARGB via strict unzlibSync). Also corrected bitmaps-jpeg3.test.ts which codified the raw-deflate bug.

TEST RESULTS: swf 1379 pass (110 files); authoring-ui 653 pass (44 files); core 5291 pass / 2 fail (ONLY task-1207 missing fixtures/flash8-empty.fla ENOENT failures in carchive-validate/contents-structure/empty-bytematch — pre-existing, allowed). All packages typecheck+build clean. e2e motion-guide.spec.ts:530 still fails = task 1214 CWS-parse harness bug, explicitly out of scope.

DOCS: docs/02-timeline-and-animation.md (geometry-origin tween + non-keyframe frame scripts), docs/09-bitmaps-imported-artwork.md (ZLIB vs raw DEFLATE).
